foils.nl: For each nonempty lower row, complete its 2-cell colored block into the 4-cell pattern indicated by the nearest matching exemplar above.
foils.code:
def transform(grid):
 d={4:7,9:2,7:6,8:4,3:3,2:9,6:7}; o=[r[:] for r in grid]
 for i in range(11,len(o)):
  r=o[i]
  if r[0]==r[1] and r[3]==r[4]==0 and r[0] in d:r[3]=r[4]=d[r[0]]
  elif r[3]==r[4] and r[0]==r[1]==0 and r[3] in d:r[0]=r[1]=d[r[3]]
 return o
